d: Victor Wembanyama continues to make NBA history with a dominant start to the season! Through his first nine games, Wemby has recorded 250+ points, 100+ rebounds, and 35+ blocks, joining Kareem Abdul-Jabbar (1975) and Shaquille O’Neal (1993) as the only players to reach those totals in their first nine games of a season since 1973-74. Wembanyama added another impressive performance with 30 points on 10-of-18 shooting, four three-pointers, and 14 rebounds as the San Antonio Spurs defeated the Sacramento Kings 124-109.
